target_customer: Analytics and data teams using dbt, Airflow or building a first data stack
problem: Analysts depend on scarce data engineers to build pipelines; data teams spend most time finding data, building pipelines and answering ad hoc requests.
business_model: B2B SaaS workspace with free trial; open source core on GitHub
product_category: AI assisted data transformation and analytics engineering workspace

founders.name: Wally Gurzynski
founders.background_notes: Led the Home Timeline team at Twitter and started a counterterrorism data and engineering team (YC page).

founders.name: Justin Leder
founders.background_notes: Led Commercial Data Science at Cruise (YC page).

founders.name: Ian Tracey
founders.background_notes: Tech lead on Stripe hosted UI and Pinterest business ML platform; autonomous drone software at Latitude (YC page).

exit.reason: YC lists the company as inactive; its website still markets the product and lists customers, and no shutdown or acquisition was found

technical_complexity.rationale: Generating and modifying dbt code with LLMs, plus lineage and catalog features, is standard engineering for three experienced engineers, with context handling as the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Builds on open source dbt and general LLMs; features were copyable by dbt Labs and other dbt tools.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: dbt Labs later launched its own Copilot per TechTarget and dbt Labs blog results from a search; exact launch dates were not verified.

market_need_then: The founders cite data teams stuck building pipelines and fielding ad hoc requests; the launch post claims it may save over 50 percent on dbt costs, a prospective claim with no metrics.

branding.domain_note: Uses turntable.so, not .com; GitHub org turntable-so.
branding.community_and_virality: Open source repo on GitHub; a data newsletter ran an interview titled mds chat w matt 2 turntable.

brand_strength.rationale: Name is shared with an unrelated music company, Turntable Labs, which dominated search results; little brand specific press found.

outcome_analysis: Turntable started as a dbt copilot and widened into a data IDE with lineage and catalog features; it raised a reported $500K pre-seed and, per its website, still lists enterprise logos, yet YC marks it inactive. No shutdown post exists, so the cause is not public. dbt Labs shipping its own AI copilot was the visible competitive pressure.
notes: The pre-seed round rests on a single database (VCBacked); CB Insights labels the same Liquid 2 Ventures round as seed dated 2023-04-28 per a search snippet, so stage is uncertain. An extruct snippet says seed stage with Y Combinator and Liquid 2 Ventures. Turntable Labs (music, $8.2M seed) is a different company and is excluded. Competitors list left empty: no source dated near the batch was found (Paradime DinoAI and others found only in undated pages).
